Mobile-first philosophy

Designed for the phone first — every page

The whole site is built mobile-first

Over 1,000 people reach CEDP every month, the majority on a phone, often mid-crisis and frequently in Spanish. So we didn't design for desktop and shrink down — we designed for the phone first and scaled up. Every page in the prototype was laid out, tested, and refined at a 380px viewport before it was ever widened: thumb-zone tap targets, single-column reading order, a persistent call bar, tel: links on every number, and bilingual access one tap away.

Get Help: a triage-first crisis flow

The Get Help page goes furthest. A sticky red call bar keeps (303) 838-1200 and the language toggle on screen at all times. A "Select your situation" panel routes clients — eviction, foreclosure, towing, utilities, debt, or other — straight to Call CARE Center Now or an online intake form, with business-hours and after-hours paths made explicit. A built-in fraud-protection banner warns that CEDP never charges fees and never contacts clients over WhatsApp.

This isn't responsive design. It's crisis design.

Editorial independence

A CMS your team controls — no developer required

A central CEDP requirement: the site has to keep pace with the work — new programs, wins, press, jobs, and team members — at all times, without waiting on an agency or a developer. We treated that as a core design goal, not an add-on. Every page is built on content structures your own staff manage directly.

Structured content types

Custom post types for Programs, Team, News & Press, Job listings, Legislative Wins, and Research. Staff add and update entries through simple forms — never code.

Block-based editing

An on-brand block editor keeps layouts consistent while content stays fully editable. No HTML, no plugins to learn, no way to accidentally break the design.

Role-based permissions

Editors, authors, and bilingual reviewers each get the right level of access — so the right people change the right things, safely.

Bilingual in-house

EN/ES content managed side by side via WPML or Polylang. Spanish is maintained by your team in-house, not outsourced every time copy changes.

Media & document library

Images, PDFs, and downloadable resources uploaded, organized, and swapped by staff in seconds — no ticket, no wait.

You own everything

Standard WordPress, open hosting, and a full admin handover. No proprietary lock-in and no recurring dependency on XTS to publish a single update.

Self-sufficient from day one: the engagement includes two live CMS training sessions plus written and video documentation. And the prototype you're reviewing already runs on these exact content structures — what your team manages after launch is what you're clicking through right now.

Phase 1 — Discovery & Design (W1–W4)

Future-state capabilities

Meridian AI — beyond the redesign

XTS's Meridian framework brings AI capabilities to CEDP's platform. These are not included in the current scope — they represent the next phase of digital transformation.

Intake

AI-Powered Crisis Triage

A conversational chatbot that asks clients about their situation in plain language (English or Spanish) and routes them to the right service — eviction, foreclosure, towing, or debt — before they reach the CARE Center. Reduces call volume and wait times.

Legal

Smart Document Analyzer

Clients photograph eviction notices, towing receipts, or debt collection letters. Meridian reads the document, identifies violations of Colorado law (Towing Bill of Rights, For Cause Eviction Act), and generates a preliminary legal assessment for CED Law attorneys.

Prevention

Predictive Eviction Risk Map

Aggregates public records, court filings, and client data to identify neighborhoods and buildings at highest risk of mass eviction — before crisis hits. Enables proactive outreach and resource deployment.

Content

Bilingual Content Intelligence

Dynamic EN/ES content adaptation that goes beyond static translation. Meridian adjusts reading level, cultural references, and legal terminology for Spanish-speaking clients — ensuring comprehension, not just translation.

Impact

Real-Time Impact Dashboard

Live visualization connecting CEDP's client data to legislative outcomes. How many families were protected by each bill? Which counties have the highest need? Automates the impact reports that funders require.

Navigation

Intelligent Resource Matching

AI-driven matching of clients to the full spectrum of available assistance — rental aid, legal representation, foreclosure counseling, and community resources — based on their specific situation, location, and eligibility. One intake, all services.

Why XTS

Xponential Technology Services (XTS) is a technology services firm under Kings Global, specializing in digital transformation for mission-driven organizations. See the full range of what we do across our offerings.

Nonprofit & advocacy experience

+

XTS actively serves nonprofit, social impact, and advocacy organizations across the US and internationally. Our team understands the unique constraints — limited budgets, volunteer-dependent content workflows, bilingual audiences, and the need to serve both crisis clients and institutional funders from the same platform.

Bilingual & multilingual projects

+

We have delivered bilingual (EN/ES) and multilingual platforms for organizations serving diverse communities. Our approach goes beyond plugin-based translation — we architect content structures that support true bilingual workflows, including separate content review, culturally adapted messaging, and language-specific SEO.

Accessibility & WCAG compliance

+

Every project includes WCAG 2.1 AA compliance as a baseline, not an add-on. Our QA process includes automated scanning (axe, Lighthouse) and manual testing with screen readers. For CEDP, this means your site is accessible to clients with visual, motor, and cognitive disabilities — a legal and ethical requirement for a publicly-funded service provider.

Data confidentiality & responsible handling

+

CEDP handles sensitive client data — names, addresses, legal cases, financial records. XTS implements:

  • SSL/TLS encryption for all data in transit
  • Role-based access controls within WordPress
  • No client PII stored in the website frontend
  • GA4 configured with anonymized IP and no PII in event parameters
  • Form submissions routed directly to Salesforce/HubSpot (not stored in WP database)
  • Security hardening: updated plugins, disabled XML-RPC, rate-limited login, security headers

Speed of delivery — the prototype proves it

+

Most agencies submit a proposal with wireframe mockups. We submitted 11 fully interactive pages with working animations, real content, and actual navigation. The prototype was built using Lumen AAE — the same methodology that powers the production build. This isn't a pitch deck. It's proof of execution.
